title: Great sleep topper which really makes a difference!
text: Great sleep topper which really makes a difference!. This is a really sweet mattress topper. First, it fits my larger depth guest bed nicely with the 15 inch deep pocket fit. Second, it is soft and cushiony and really makes a difference from sleeping on the mattress on it's own. Third, it washes easily and comes out of the wash looking like new. I have twin beds in my guest room, so I have two of these now and I have had a load of compliments on how soft and comfortable the beds are (while still maintaining support). I highly recommend this Sleep Mantra brand to use and improve your nightly sleep régime.

product_metadata.title: Sleep Mantra King Cooling Mattress Topper, Pillow-Top Optimum Thickness, Soft 100% Cotton Fabric, Breathable & Plush Quilted Down-Like Fill, Snug Deep Pocket fit for Mattresses 8-20 inch, White
features: OPTIMAL THICKNESS FOR SUPPORT, BREATHABILITY & COMFORTABLE SLEEP: Our mattress topper offers optimum thickness. The 300 thread count 100% cotton topper provides strong support and prevents back ache, unlike extra thick pads. Our mattress topper does nor retain heat and maintains optimal temperature. No more sweaty nights caused by memory foam pads or traditional mattresses.

SOFT MATTRESS TOPPER WITH DEEP POCKET FOR A PERFECT FIT: The gusseted Twin size mattress topper is 39" W x 75" L with a 18" deep pocket skirt, perfectly fitting mattresses up to 20" deep. Stuffed with advanced 100% Polyester Fibers (Down Alternative) fill that has a soft and bouncy feel. Our square pillow top mattress pad adds a layer of protection, comfort and softness to your new mattress providing a hotel-like experience. It can also be used to refresh and support old spring mattresses.

EASY TO USE, STAIN & WATER REPELLENT: The topper will help protect your mattress from stains and spills as the material is treated with one of the world's top fabric protectors that repels liquids and blocks stains without compromising on the feel. Also, the spilled fluid can be easily wiped, so the water does not seep through and reach your mattress. The topper is foldable and portable, and has a fitted skirt that makes it easy to put on and remove for cleaning.

BEST VALUE, EASY TO WASH MATTRESS TOPPER: Since the product comes in a vacuum bag, tumble dry the mattress cover on low heat before use to let the air fluff it up. This mattress topper is easy to clean, fully machine washable, and retains shape and fill consistency wash after wash due to its advanced down-like fill quality, unlike other pads that become deformed, flat and lumpy after few washes. To increase durability, protect the mattress pad with a fitted sheet to reduce the need to wash it.

SNUG AND COZY FEELING: With an extra plush thick padding and soft quilted surface, this luxury odor-free mattress topper promises to offer supreme comfort and a night of restful sleep. Certified STANDARD 100 by OEKO-TEX , topper pad is tested to be safe from 300+ harmful chemicals. Rest assured, if you're not happy with our mattress toppers, write to us and we will resolve your query within 1 business day.
